messages:
Ravi K: Hi all - quick one. Took a late night taxi from conference to hotel, driver gave a printed docket with time but no VAT line. Can I upload a photo of that? Also I left the next morning at 10:30 AM  do I claim any per diem for the return day?
Jordan (People Ops): Hi Ravi :wave: photo of the docket is fine for taxis. Make sure date, time and amount are clear. If merchant name is missing add 'Taxi operator' + city in notes.
Ravi K: thanks. The total was £42 and paid cash, no card trace. Anything else I should include?
Maya (Finance): For cash taxis, include the photo and add a short explanation. If >£50 we may request an attestation. Per diem: our policy is pro-rated. Leaving at 10:30 usually means half-day if total away is 6-12h; if your trip start/return times make it less than 6h then none. Add your travel times in notes.
Ravi K: Got it, I'll add note 'left conference 09:00, taxi 23:15 arrival, returned 10:30 next day' and submit as Travel:Transport.
ExpensesBot: Expense guide: https://company.docs/expenses/travel ; Receipts help: https://company.docs/expenses/receipts
Jordan (People Ops): Approved from People Ops. Finance will review for attestation if required. Ping here if they ask for extra info. :white_check_mark:
